diagnoses.symptom: A quarter of pull requests merged with no recorded review, and the first review took a median of three days.

hypotheses.cause: Nothing assigns a reviewer, so review happens only when someone volunteers.
hypotheses.prediction: Unreviewed pull requests are spread across authors and sizes; if not, they cluster on one author or on large changes.

hypotheses.cause: Large pull requests take too long to review.
hypotheses.prediction: The first-review wait grows with change size; if not, small changes wait as long.
Waits cluster in freeze weeks; if not, they are even across weeks.
hypotheses.needs: b-domain deployment records, which this run did not extract

root_cause.rendered: Nothing assigns a reviewer when a pull request opens.
root_cause.boundary: Records cannot show whether unassigned review is a choice. Ask the team who owns review.

remedies.name: Reviewer rotation
remedies.how: Assigns a reviewer to every pull request that has none.

remedies.name: Require one approval in branch protection
remedies.how: No pull request merges without a reviewer.
